dense: Eight marbles. *One* swipe at a time.

hook: Tilt the board, and every marble rolls at once.
Here is a puzzle made entirely of gravity.
One swipe moves every marble on the board.
Can you roll every marble home?
mechanic: Each marble rolls until something stops it, then drops into the hole of its own colour.
Every swipe moves them all, so the trick is planning where they will end up.
Marbles roll as far as they can, and fall into their matching holes.
hint: Stuck? A hint shows exactly where every marble would land.
The hint previews your next tilt, marble by marble.
If you get stuck, ask for a hint and watch the route appear.
win: Solve it in the fewest moves for three stars.
Match par, and the perfect route earns three stars.
Find the shortest route to earn every star.
fail: Careful: square pits swallow any marble. Undo is always one tap away.
Fall into a pit and simply undo, then try another way.
dense: The boards grow, the colours multiply, but the rule never changes.
Later levels pack in more marbles, more walls, and more ways to go wrong.
stats: A hundred and twenty levels, and every single one is solvable.
No timers, no lives, no rush. Just you and the marbles.
